title: How to upgrade the pixel art ?
author: Ostermiss
selftext:
Hello,

I am vibe coding game boy games ! This is a capture of an emulator, but my issue is “cupkid”, the demake of cuphead, is a little “weird” I would like to enhance his sprite but I tried do it manually with no success ! What do you use for pixel art ?

replies.author: Ostermiss
replies.body: 😮 thanks ! Opus 5.5 seems really good to code game boy games, really difficult to have steady fps, but he is doing a good work

comments.author: Fuey500
comments.body: You could always learn how to draw more. knowing the fundamentals of good pixel art would help with ai use anyway.

replies.author: Ostermiss
replies.body: I tried myself but what is in my mind is really complicated to apply on paper 😂

replies.author: Fuey500
replies.body: Just takes time, the more you draw the better you get. Can lookup some tutorials, the same principles they teach you will also be ones you apply when telling the AI to make art.

comments.author: Left-Excitement3829
comments.body: I like it as is tbh

comments.author: odragora
comments.body:
Generating references with something like GPT-Image 2.5 or pixel art image gen services is the first thing that comes to mind.

But I personally like the style in this version too.

comments.author: pickleunicorn
comments.body: Nothing related to what you're asking for, but when an enemy is hit it should blink :p

comments.author: Immured_gamedev
comments.body: Some kind of effect to show your hits are affecting the boss?
